name: Synthesia
description: Synthesia turns text into videos with AI presenters and dubbing, with a free Basic plan and Starter, Pro and Enterprise plans.
features: Survey responses and promotional 'Syren' videos in plan limits
strengths: Yearly billing lowers the monthly price
limitations: The free plan is limited to about 10 minutes of Studio video
Free trial terms are not stated

plans.name: Basic
limits: 10 minutes of Studio video creation or dubbing

plans.name: Starter
plans.note: $29 billed monthly, or $18 a month ($216 billed yearly). 15,000 credits a year on the yearly plan.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: $89 billed monthly, or $64 a month ($768 billed yearly). 72,000 credits a year on the yearly plan.

free.details: Basic: 500 credits per month, 10 minutes of Studio video creation or dubbing.

profile.headline: AI video for business teams, with avatars, translation and dubbing

capabilities.title: Make a video from a script
capabilities.text: AI Avatars present your script on screen.

capabilities.title: Turn a document into video
capabilities.text: The Assistant can create a video from a dropped file or a pasted URL.

capabilities.title: Translate and dub
capabilities.text: Translate or dub a video into more than 140 languages, with glossary controls for consistent terms.

capabilities.title: Record and narrate your screen
capabilities.text: The AI Screen Recorder records and narrates your screen.

featureCards.name: Brand Kits, roles and approval
featureCards.text: Keep videos on-brand and approve them before they go live.

featureCards.name: Flexible publishing
featureCards.text: Publish as a link, an embed or a SCORM package; edits update everywhere the video is shared.

featureCards.name: Built-in analytics
featureCards.text: See views, clicks and completion rates.

featureCards.name: Roleplay Sessions
featureCards.text: Practise conversations such as sales and discovery calls with avatars.

featureCards.name: Survey Sessions
featureCards.text: Conversational surveys for employee insights, customer insights and lead qualification.

featureCards.name: API
featureCards.text: Interactive Avatars in your own product, plus dubbing and video creation by API.

audienceDetail.text: Technical, compliance and sales training videos.

scenarios.title: Compliance training
scenarios.text: Make a training video from a policy document and update it later in one place.

scenarios.title: Onboarding videos
scenarios.text: Welcome new staff with a consistent avatar presenter.

scenarios.title: Product videos in many languages
scenarios.text: Dub one video into other languages with a glossary for product terms.

scenarios.title: Sales role play
scenarios.text: Practise a discovery call with an avatar.

gettingStarted.text: The site says the Basic plan is free with no credit card, with 500 credits a month, up to 10 minutes of video.
